# Original credibility assets

`previous-work-logos.json` records source page, exact asset URL, retrieval date, local file, byte size, dimensions and SHA-256. `scripts/import-credibility-logos.mjs` imports originals. Raster files are resized without enlargement and losslessly encoded as WebP; SVG paths/colors are preserved. No screenshots, approximations or AI-generated marks.

The visible relationship explanation makes these descriptive experience references, without implying direct independent-client status for every organization, endorsement, certification or partnership. Trademark/copyright rights remain with owners; public availability does not transfer ownership or create a blanket trademark license. Preserve colors, clear space, proportions and background contrast. AWS provenance is a legitimate icon library, not an asserted official media download. Never substitute retail Amazon branding.
